title: The Secret Hands Behind South Africa's Xenophobia

sense.text:
“Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months.” The beginning of our months is the new moon, and the new moon is also called the days of our gladness.

Meaning on these days we are supposed to be happy, not sorrowful. Not dragging ourselves in like it is a chore, like going back to school again. It is the day of our gladness.

“Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.” Having joy in the Lord, that is where we get our strength.

Read the whole history: they were there from morning to afternoon being taught the law. They were being taught the Bible all over again, and when they heard the law they started crying: damn, we messed up. They were sorrowful for all the evil they had been doing. So Nehemiah tells them, Listen, don’t be sorrowful. You did a lot of things wrong, and now you are learning what you are supposed to do, but the joy of the Lord is your strength.

So for those brothers and sisters that are always sorrowful: that is an evil spirit, man. The only way you can get strength is from having joy in the Lord. And if you do not have joy in learning the wisdom of God, you have to pray and ask God for that.

precepts.why:
How do you be joyful in the Lord? Christ “entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house. And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.” Mary sat at his feet and heard his word, meaning she was learning the scriptures from Christ, hearing all that wisdom coming from him. She wanted him to stay.

“But Martha was cumbered about much serving.” Like our sisters that get caught up in the kitchen serving, bringing the coffee and the tea. That is a good job. If you give the prophets just a glass of water, you are going to get your blessing. But Martha said, “Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.” Lord, you don’t care? I’m doing this by myself and it’s hard; tell her to come help me.

See how Christ dealt with it: “Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things”: you worry about too many things. “But one thing is needful”, needful for every last one of us that wakes up to this truth. “And Mary hath chosen that good part.” The best part is learning wisdom. The serving is good, but what Mary chose, wisdom, is better.

“Which shall not be taken away from her.” As you brothers and sisters learn these scriptures and understand them, that can never be taken away from you. That is what the joy of the Lord is.

“Wine and musick rejoice the heart.” When you drink some wine you feel nice and your heart is merry; you listen to music and have fun. On the feast days we play music and everybody is dancing. So is the joy of the Lord just wine and music on the feast days?

“But the love of wisdom is above them both.” It is okay to drink wine and okay to listen to music and make your heart merry, but above them both is wisdom: what Mary was learning when she sat down by Christ and listened to all his words. That is the better part.

So the same joy you have for wine and music, you are supposed to have, and more, for wisdom. The joy of the Lord is not just having fun on the feast days; it is learning wisdom. That is why every feast day and every new moon we go over the scriptures, and that is supposed to be above the wine and the music later on.

You are supposed to be excited to learn wisdom, not sitting there wishing the class would hurry up because it has been two hours. You are learning things that have not been taught for over 2,000 years, or that we forgot. When a brother pulls a scripture you should be like, Yo, that’s a bad scripture right there, let me write that down. The same way our forefathers were joyful learning the laws all over again, the joy we are supposed to have is not just wine, not just music: it is wisdom.

sense.text:
“Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded.” You always hear about conspiracy theories. Esau always puts that out there: any time anybody speaks truth, they throw out, Oh, you’re a conspiracy theorist, so the public won’t believe you.

But the scriptures say the nations have wicked conspiracies. They have wicked conspiracies against us; they are doing things secretly to destroy our people. There are conspiracies set up on this earth against us. That is the secret hand behind the xenophobia in South Africa: everything going on there, the white man, the CIA and Mossad are behind it.

precepts.why:
“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord.” There are people seeking to hide the evil they are doing. “And their works are in the dark”: like how these operatives, the CIA and Mossad, go into a country and murder leaders and cause civil unrest, and think nobody sees what they are doing. Doing it in the dark means hiding it.

“And they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” Who sees what we are doing, and who knows what we are doing? This is what the wicked does. This is what the US government and the Israeli government are doing.

“Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay.” The same way they turn everything upside down and cause all that confusion, it shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: the potter has the power to turn things back the way they are supposed to be.

“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked.” The wicked have secret councils, and we want God to hide us from them. “From the insurrection of the workers of iniquity”: the rising up of the workers of iniquity.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words”: they use their tongue, their words, as a weapon. “That they may shoot in secret at the perfect.” The perfect is the 12 tribes of Israel. The bitter words are the things they say secretly and put out there to confuse our people, to cause problems and uprisings. “Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not”: they call us a hate group, they call us all types of names, and they don’t fear God when they speak their lies against us.

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter.” The ADL and the US government are doing a lot of evil on this earth against the 12 tribes of Israel. “They commune of laying snares privily”: they sit down and talk amongst themselves about setting traps privately. Traps to assassinate leaders, to overthrow countries, to cause civil unrest, to murder the prophets, to get us locked up in prison for things we did not do. How can we destroy these people? How can we destroy this government? “They say, Who shall see them?” Who sees the traps we are setting up?

“Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.” Their heart is deep: when they set things up, they are thinking a hundred steps ahead.

“Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed”: the Lord is coming forth for the salvation of his people, the 12 tribes of Israel. “Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked”: the head of the house of the wicked is America, and Christ is going to destroy America when he returns. “By discovering the foundation unto the neck”: he is going to cut their head off, and nothing is going to remain.

“Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages”: their cities. “They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: they come out to scatter Christ and the angels when he returns.

“Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.” Everything they do to destroy us is done secretly, through their secret service: Mossad and the CIA. They have organizations set up to destroy us secretly.

And we put that on an individual level, but it is us as a whole, as a people, as a nation. It is talking about Venezuela, Guatemala, Panama, the Sahel, Cuba, South Africa and Nigeria, because our people are there too. Not just us waking up in America: all our people all over the world. They destroy us secretly with the food, with the vaccine, with the music. So we have to mold our minds to think on an international level, because this truth is not just about the United States. When Malcolm X realized his people were being oppressed all over Africa and the world and started linking up with leaders there, they said, We got to kill this guy. Israel is global; our people are scattered globally.

sense.text:
“How are the things of Esau searched out!” The things of Esau are the things he has done secretly. “How are his hidden things sought up!” The hidden things are what he is doing and hiding from the world.

How are they searched out and brought out? We have to bring it out. We are the ones that have to search out the hidden things Esau is doing and hiding from the world; it is our job to see what he is doing and bring it out. And how is it brought up? By the spirit of God. God puts his spirit on us and we go forth and reveal him.

precepts.why:
“And then shall that Wicked be revealed.” The wicked is Esau, and the wicked must be revealed. It is our job to search out the secret things he is hiding and reveal them.

Why does the wicked need to be revealed? Because the wicked is acting like he is righteous, like he is holy. So it is up to the servants of God to search out his hidden things and his secrets and show the world: this man is the wicked. He is not righteous, he is not about justice, he is not about rights. He is revealed when we search out all the hidden things and all the lies he has been pushing on this earth.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”: the spirit of the Lord’s mouth starts first and foremost with us teaching; that is how he is being revealed. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: when the Lord returns he will destroy the wicked, he will destroy Esau.

This is why the topic is the secret hands behind the xenophobia in South Africa: there are secret organizations over there causing all that chaos.

“Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.” How are the hidden things of Esau sought up? There is nothing the white man hides that God is not going to reveal to us. Whatever he did or is doing and trying to hide from the world, the Lord is going to make us know it.

“What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light”: what God reveals to us, go speak it and let everybody hear. “That preach ye upon the housetops”: speak it openly.

“And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul.” Christ is saying, when I reveal to you the things Esau is hiding and you teach it, don’t fear them. You might get killed for what you are teaching. What the US government and the Israeli government are doing in South Africa is a hidden thing, a secret, and it could get you killed. But we have to do what we have to do. As you reveal who the wicked is they are going to try to kill you, and they will kill some of you, but don’t fear: they might kill your body, but they can’t kill your soul.

sense.text:
“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand.” This is what the white man always does, and this is what he is doing to South Africa.

Mossad and the CIA are trying to turn all the other African countries, Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe, against South Africa. How? They have paid agents. A lot of those people rising up, marching and beating people in the streets are paid agents; some are just stupid and following it, saying they are taking my job. But there are culprits behind it: the CIA and Mossad, to destabilize South Africa and to weaken BRICS. America is trying to destroy all those nations that are part of BRICS: Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, and South Africa is one of the founders.

The synagogues of Satan wrote it out plainly in the Times of Israel: Africa must fragment, South Africa first. A fragment is a small piece broken off from a larger whole. They want Nigeria, Ghana, Ethiopia and all the other African countries to separate from South Africa, and that will isolate South Africa and weaken it. They even wrote that South Africa’s foreign policy is aligned with Iran, through BRICS naval exercises; that is why South Africa has to be destabilized. And you see African countries falling into the trick bag: Ghana taking South Africa to the African Union and refusing to renew its gold fields, Mozambique stopping South African trucks at the border. That is divide and rule.

Any nation divided shall not stand. So South Africa is about to fall: that is their plan, to divide South Africa and destroy it. When the whole of Africa is divided, that is how Esau is able to destroy them; they keep the countries divided because that is the only way they can retain power.

precepts.why:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” That is what you see taking place right now: America and Israel are trying to weaken South Africa.

How? By causing civil unrest. That xenophobia you see is really Afrophobia, black on black crime, done to make it look like South Africa can’t govern themselves, that they are a failed state. Then the Afrikaners are going to rise back and take back that government. That is what is going to happen.

It is the same thing they did in 1989. A white officer of the South African army told how their special soldiers trained Zulu men and sent them into the townships and the mine hostels to fight the other tribes, to make it look like black on black crime and take the eyes off what the Afrikaners were doing to the people. Then the whites said, these blacks can’t run a country, they are always fighting each other. What you see taking place right now is the same thing, and the ones beating people in the streets are paid to do it: state-sponsored violence.

sense.text:
“And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold”: they are going to take every stronghold.

How will they take it? “For they shall heap dust, and take it.” The dust is the confusion: the civil uprising, the xenophobia or Afrophobia you see going on in South Africa right now. And it is going to get worse, and it is the CIA and Mossad behind it. As it gets worse, the white people are going to step in and take back that country from the black South Africans.

And Nigeria is not going to feel sorry for them, Zimbabwe is not going to feel sorry for them, none of these countries, because propaganda was put out there that all South Africans hate black people, that all South Africans hate Nigeria. It is a trap; that is why the media pushes it so hard. They are going to heap dust and take South Africa.

Why? It is payback. South Africa took the synagogues of Satan to court on genocide charges, and South Africa is in BRICS with Iran and Russia, so they are going to get rid of that whole government and bring back the Afrikaners. Erik Prince of Blackwater said it already: if these countries are incapable of governing themselves, it is time to put the imperial hat back on and govern them. That is what is about to take place in South Africa; they are not going to allow black people to govern themselves any more, not even here in America, where they change up the districts and get rid of black senators.

“So shall righteousness hate iniquity.” That is how we must hate iniquity: all the evil we see them doing. “When she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face.” Our job is to accuse them to their face and let them know that what they are doing is evil. What you are doing in South Africa is evil. The secret conspiracy to destroy and destabilize South Africa, to turn tribesmen against each other and countries against each other, is evil. Let the white man know he is evil, let the Israeli government know, let the US government know, let the Afrikaners know they are evil for what they are doing.

“When he cometh that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.” What is our job, brothers? To diligently search out every sin upon earth: every sin and wickedness the white man is hiding, search it out, bring it forth, and let Esau know he is wicked and evil. And how we are able to see these things is that the spirit of God shows it to us.

“And therefore be ye not like thereunto, nor to the works thereof. For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.” Just a little while and iniquity is going to be taken away from the earth, and righteousness is going to reign.
“Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid?” The trumpet is us teaching. What are we telling the people is going to take place on this earth? Oppression is coming.
“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” God reveals his secrets unto us, and our job is to teach it.
“The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?” When God speaks to us, our job is to prophesy.

“Publish in the palaces at Ashdod.” Ashdod is in the land of Israel: who we have to prophesy against is the Amalek, those people that are in the land of Israel. “And in the palaces in the land of Egypt”: the land of Egypt is America. God says prophesy against them, Israel and America. They are the two behind what you see going on in South Africa and behind much of the evil taking place on the earth, even what is going on in the Congo; Israel is behind that too.

“For they know not to do right”: the white man doesn’t know how to do right. “Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces”: this is what America does and what the Israeli government does. They store up violence and robbery in their palaces, in their countries.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land.” God is going to raise up an adversary against them. That adversary is the Medes, which is Iran: God will raise up the Medes against America. America is not going to destroy Iran; Trump is not going to destroy Iran. “And he shall bring down thy strength from thee”: their strength is going to be brought down. That is what you see taking place.
